decisions.description: Checks whether the record was just marked Blacklisted, or Do Not Call and Email Opt Out, on this update. Only then is the Status set to Do Not Engage, matching the flow's original entry criteria.
decisions.name: Do_Not_Engage_Criteria_Met
decisions.label: Do Not Engage Criteria Met?

decisions.description: Checks whether the Title changed on this update, so the Seniority Level is only recalculated when the Title changes.
decisions.name: Title_Changed

Flow.description: Sets the Status to Do Not Engage if the record is Blacklisted or DNC and Email Opt Out. Sets the Seniority Level based on the Title when the Title changes.

formulas.description: True when the record is now Blacklisted, or Do Not Call and Email Opt Out, and was not before this update.

formulas.description: Returns the Seniority Level picklist API name based on the Title. Checks the Title against the Seniority Ranking keywords in order; the first keyword the Title contains sets the level. Scores 0-1 and Titles with no matching keyword return blank, which clears the field.
